image_description: A full suit of dark, polished metal armor displayed on a mannequin in a museum setting. The armor features a segmented breastplate (cuirass) with horizontal ridges, shoulder guards (pauldrons), and a helmet with a visor. The surface is highly reflective, showing specular highlights from museum lighting. Background includes display cases and informational posters.

The horizontal bands on the lower part of the armor show slight waviness and inconsistent thickness, suggesting minor geometric instability in the rigid metal structure.
